feature_order: rel_goal_12_14: relative goal unit vector in body FLU [gx, gy, gz]
body_vel_15_17: estimated body velocity [vx, vy, vz] in m/s
yaw_rate_22: body yaw rate in rad/s
observation_contract.bilateral_reflection_invariance: For centered obstacle on centerline, ray pairs swap and lateral components are zero, creating identical reflected input vector

low_speed_standoff_state_metrics.interpretation: CRITICAL FINDING: The training dataset contains ZERO transitions where the UAV is in front of an obstacle (<0.50m) at low speed (<0.20 m/s). The safety supervisor standoff hover is 100% out-of-distribution (OOD) for the BC policy.

velocity_shortcut_correlation.interpretation: High correlation (r > 0.85) between current body velocity and target velocity causes the MLP to rely on momentum rather than initiating lateral evasions from standstill.
